task.name: Read_fresh_water_tank_level
task.when: At shift start and every 2 hours during a Dominatrix shift

step.action: Inspect the tank, outlet, and ground for a visible leak.
step.ifThen: IF a leak is present, THEN stop using the tank and tell the Dominatrix immediately.

step.action: Observe the fresh-water level without opening the tank.
Tell the Dominatrix the level reading.

passWhen.criterion: The Dominatrix received the fresh-water level reading.
